hearth.rhythm.round.done: Drinks are on %s! A health to you.
hearth.rhythm.round.short: You're short of the coin for that, friend.
hearth.rhythm.when.today: Today: %1$s is at %2$s. The bell rings before it.
hearth.rhythm.when.days: On the rest day, in %2$s days: %1$s at %3$s.
hearth.rhythm.when.none: We keep no %s here, I'm sorry to say.
hearth.rhythm.first_snow: First snow in %s. Folk stay in by the fire.
